order: Each fixture in turn, f1 to f5, one run at a time. The single reviewer goes first on f1, f3 and f5, the council on f2 and f4.
stops: Before each run, with no inference request, nothing is sent when: the engine's endpoint (from doctor) isn't Token Factory; the model the engine would pick from Token Factory's listing (read with the engine's own client and pick) isn't the protocol's; or the sampling the engine gives that model isn't the protocol's.
After each run, as a second check: its recorded route, model or sampling isn't the protocol's.
A run fails with auth or rate-limit.
A run makes more requests than its arm allows.
A run still going when its window to settle after a cancel has passed: it is kept as unresolved, and never sent again.
The next run, with its windows to cancel and to settle, could not end within the batch's 60 minutes.

decision.inconclusive: Fewer than 4 fixtures have a report from both arms.
decision.defer: Any of: the council's known defects plus useful novel findings are no more than the single reviewer's; the council has at least 3 more unsupported findings; the council has at least 2 more false alarms on the control; at most 2 of the council's 5 runs are complete.
decision.adopt: All of: the council finds at least 2 more known defects; at least 3 more known defects plus useful novel findings; at most 1 more unsupported finding; no more false alarms on the control; at least 4 of its 5 runs complete; a median latency ratio of at most 3.0; a median token ratio of at most 5.0, or unknown and said so; actionability no more than 0.10 below the single reviewer's.
